sentences.en: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
sentences.zh: 那两个部门有时会意见不合。

sentences.en: The odds are against me, so I think I'll quit now.
sentences.zh: 看来希望渺茫，我想我现在就放弃吧。

sentences.en: Proponents of increased import duties are at odds with each other.
sentences.zh: 支持增加进口关税的人之间存在分歧。

senses.zh: 可能的机会, 成败的可能性, 优势, 不均, 不平等, 几率, 差别。
